column1: A replay loops, so the pundit can talk over it for as long as he likes. He likes.
column2: Pāʻani hou nō ka hoʻolei hou, i hiki i ka loea ke kamaʻilio e like me kona makemake. Nui kona makemake.

column1: Here's number 22. Number 22 has the ball. That's important, because the ball is how you score.
column2: Eia ka helu 22. Aia ka pōpō i ka helu 22. He mea nui kēlā, ʻo ka pōpō ke ala e loaʻa ai ka helu.

column1: The pen goes over the replay, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Aia ka peni ma luna o ka hoʻolei hou, ma kona papa iho. Kaomi + ma ka hopena o nā kapu papa helu.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first.
column2: He papa ka papa helu lua ma luna o ka mua.

column1: Over it. Not under it. Under it, you can't see it. That's football.
column2: Ma luna. ʻAʻole ma lalo. Ma lalo, ʻaʻole ʻike ʻia. Pēlā ka pōpeku.

column1: The lit tab is where SOURCE puts things. Skip this and the ink lands under the replay.
column2: Ma ka kapu ʻā e waiho ai ʻo KUMU i nā mea. Lele i kēia, a waiho ka ʻīnika ma lalo o ka hoʻolei hou.

column1: See that tab? Click it. Fundamentals.
column2: ʻIke i kēlā kapu? Kaomi. Nā kumu.
Ma ka papa helu 2: KUMU, a laila Kaha.

column1: A Draw cue is clear wherever there is no ink, so the replay shows through.
column2: Mōakāka ka cue Kaha ma kahi ʻīnika ʻole, no laila ʻike ʻia ka hoʻolei hou ma lalo.

column1: Give me the pen. I've waited all season for the pen.
column2: Hāʻawi mai i ka peni. Ua kali au i ke kau holoʻokoʻa no ka peni.

column1: Both are live now: the replay underneath, the ink on top.
column2: Ke hoʻolele nei lāua: ka hoʻolei hou ma lalo, ka ʻīnika ma luna.

column1: We're on the air. Nobody touches the pen but me.
column2: Aia kākou ma ka hoʻolele. ʻO wau wale nō ke hoʻopā i ka peni.

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then circle number 22 on the programme monitor. He is the yellow one.
column2: Kaomi Kaha ma ka mea nānā, a kaha pōʻai a puni ka helu 22 ma ka pale papahana. ʻO ka mea melemele.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength.
column2: Mānoanoa ke kaha i ke kaomi o ka peni. Hoʻokahi wale ka ikaika o ke kaomi ʻiole.

column1: Circle him! The yellow one! There's only one yellow one. Circle that one.
column2: Pōʻai iā ia! Ka melemele! Hoʻokahi wale nō melemele. Pōʻai i kēlā!

column1: Draw as much as you like. Then SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, in the playlist.
column2: Kaha e like me kou makemake. Mālama ʻo mālama i ke kiʻi paʻa i ke kaha ma ke ʻano he kiʻi me ke kua mōakāka ma ka papa helu.

column1: For next week's show. He will want that circle again.
column2: No ka hōʻike o kēia pule aʻe. E makemake hou ʻo ia i kēlā pōʻai.

column1: Put that in the Hall of Fame. Next to the turducken.
column2: Waiho i ka hale kaulana. Ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka pelehū me ka ʻūpē a me ka moa i loko.

column1: Halftime. Click the Deck 1 tab, then SOURCE, then Video Synth.
column2: Ka wā hoʻomaha. Kaomi i ka kapu Papa 1, a laila KUMU, a laila Synth wikiō.

column1: My favourite source: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. A halftime show with no camera at all.
column2: Kaʻu kumu punahele: nā oscillator, nā aniani, a me ka hoʻihoʻi. He hōʻike hoʻomaha me ka ʻole o ke kāmela.

column1: Halftime! Somebody get me some lights. And a band. And a sandwich.
column2: Ka wā hoʻomaha! E lawe mai i nā kukui. He hui mele hoʻi. A he sanwika.

column1: Select the synth and TAKE it. Then look at the monitor: your ink is still up.
column2: Koho i ka synth a kaomi TAKE. Nānā i ka pale: aia nō kou ʻīnika.

column1: Playlist 2 did not change, so its ink stays over whatever playlist 1 shows. Each playlist changes on its own.
column2: ʻAʻole i loli ka papa helu 2, no laila mau kona ʻīnika ma luna o ka mea a ka papa helu 1 e hōʻike ai. Loli kēlā papa helu iā ia iho.

column1: Leave the circle up. It's a good circle. It goes with everything.
column2: Waiho i ka pōʻai. He pōʻai maikaʻi. Kūpono i nā mea a pau.

column1: A test pattern, a replay, ink on a layer, a still, and halftime. That's the booth.
column2: He kiʻi hoʻāʻo, he hoʻolei hou, he ʻīnika ma ka papa, he kiʻi paʻa, he hoʻomaha. ʻO ia ke keʻena hoʻolaha.

column1: Replay in the Draw section draws your lines back the way you drew them. He will love that.
column2: Na Replay ma ka ʻāpana Kaha e kaha hou i kou mau laina e like me kāu i kaha ai. E hauʻoli ʻo ia.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen.
column2: Kēia manawa nō i kēia pule aʻe. Lawe mai i peni nui aʻe.

column1: Now THAT is a busy play. I can't see the field. I love it.
column2: ʻO KĒLĀ ke pāʻani huikau. ʻAʻole ʻike au i ke kahua. Makemake au.

column1: Two projectors overlap, and each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright. Watch the sides of the monitor go soft.
column2: Kau ʻelua mea hoʻolei kiʻi ma luna o kekahi, a mae kēlā lihi i pāpālua ʻole ka mālamalama. Nānā i nā ʻaoʻao o ka pale e palupalu ana.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and a host who is not here tonight. Press START.
column2: He pāʻani nīnau, skapi. ʻEkolu mea hoʻokūkū, hoʻokahi bele, a he alakaʻi ʻaʻole ma ʻaneʻi i kēia pō. Kaomi Hoʻomaka.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines.
column2: Nā helu cue, nā kī pōkole, a me GO mai nā mīkini ʻē.

column1: Forty years I turned the letters. Tonight they gave me the microphone. Nobody panic.
column2: He kanahā makahiki koʻu hoʻohuli ʻana i nā huapalapala. I kēia pō ua hāʻawi mai i ka mea hoʻoleo. Mai pīhoihoi.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Hāʻawi ka hale keaka i nā helu cue: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Heluhelu ʻo Deckboy iā lākou a pau.

column1: Numbers! I know letters. Numbers are letters that went to college.
column2: Nā helu! Maopopo iaʻu nā huapalapala. He huapalapala nā helu i hele i ke kulanui.

column1: GOTO crosses a long list faster than scrolling. Much faster.
column2: ʻOi loa ka wikiwiki o GOTO ma ka papa lōʻihi ma mua o ka ʻōwili ʻana. ʻOi loa.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one is a buzzer.
column2: F1 a F10, F12, a i ʻole ka papa kī helu. He bele kēlā me kēia.

column1: Every contestant gets a buzzer. I get the letters. It's fine. It's fine.
column2: Loaʻa ka bele i kēlā mea hoʻokūkū. Loaʻa iaʻu nā huapalapala. Maikaʻi nō. Maikaʻi nō.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Only the key.
column2: ʻAʻohe ʻiole, ʻaʻohe papa, ʻaʻohe nānā. Ke kī wale nō.

column1: Buzz! A winner! I've never said that. I've only pointed at it.
column2: Kani! He lanakila! ʻAʻole au i ʻōlelo pēlā ma mua. Ua kuhikuhi wale au.

column1: And for our viewers at home: yes, you can push the buttons too.
column2: A no nā mea nānā ma ka hale: ʻae, hiki iā ʻoukou ke kaomi i nā pihi hoʻi.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You could host a game show now.
column2: Nā helu, GOTO, he bele, a me GO mai nā wahi a pau. Hiki iā ʻoe ke alakaʻi i pāʻani nīnau i kēia manawa.

column1: Goodnight, everybody! Tomorrow I go back to the letters. I'll miss you.
column2: Aloha pō kākou! ʻApōpō hoʻi au i nā huapalapala. E minamina au iā ʻoukou.

column1: And the number is... not three. I'll allow it. I turn anything.
column2: A ʻo ka helu... ʻaʻole ʻekolu. ʻAe nō. Hoʻohuli au i nā mea a pau.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. For now.
column2: He papa ka papa helu lua ma luna o ka palapala ʻāina. Noho ka moʻo ma lalo. No kēia manawa.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio.
column2: He Lower Third, he inoa, he kāleka poʻo, he kua. Ua haʻalele ka moʻo i ke keʻena.

column1: That's not my name. It's a lovely name. Now, about that lizard...
column2: ʻAʻole kēlā koʻu inoa. He inoa nani. I kēia manawa, no kēlā moʻo...

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, an inventor who wants cheese, and a dog who does the real work. Press START.
column2: He moku ahi i hana ʻia ma lalo o ka hale, skapi, he mea haku makemake i ka waiūpaʻa paʻa, a he ʻīlio hana i ka hana maoli. Kaomi Hoʻomaka.

column1: Stage timers: a countdown over a picture, a hold, and a view for the person on stage.
column2: Nā uaki kahua: helu iho ma luna o ke kiʻi, paʻa, a he nānā no ke kanaka ma ke kahua.

column1: Playlist 2 is selected, over the rocket. SOURCE, then Stage Timer.
column2: Ua koho ʻia ka papa helu 2, ma luna o ka moku ahi. KUMU, a laila Stage Timer.

column1: *checks his watch, then the rocket, then his watch*
column2: *nānā i kona uaki, i ka moku ahi, a i kona uaki hou*

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. I have cleared its backdrop, so the rocket shows behind the numbers.
column2: Koho i ka uaki a kaomi TAKE. Ua kāpae au i kona kua i ʻike ʻia ka moku ahi ma hope o nā helu.

column1: Past zero it keeps going and counts the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: Hala ka ʻole, hoʻomau ka helu ʻana i ka manawa keu. Pololei loa. Hoʻohilahila iki.

column1: Close MENU, click the Deck 1 tab, then select 'The rocket (lift-off)' and TAKE it.
column2: Pani i PAPA KUHIKUHI, kaomi i ka kapu Papa 1, koho iā 'The rocket (lift-off)' a kaomi TAKE.

column1: The clock is on playlist 2, so it stays up while the rocket changes underneath it.
column2: Aia ka uaki ma ka papa helu 2, no laila mau ʻo ia i ka loli ʻana o ka moku ahi ma lalo.

column1: We have lift-off, Grommet! ...Grommet? Who's flying it?
column2: Ke lele nei kākou, Grommet! ...Grommet? Na wai e hoʻokele?

column1: A countdown, a hold, a pilot's view and a launch. Bring crackers.
column2: He helu iho, he paʻa, he nānā pailaka, he hoʻolele. Lawe mai i nā pahūpahū.

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a rubber chicken, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: He hōʻike kilokilo, skapi. He pahu, he moa laholio, a hoʻokahi paʻi e loli pū ai nā mea a pau. Kaomi Hoʻomaka.

column1: Two playlists are two layers, and TAKE ALL changes both together. Tonight you will see why that matters.
column2: ʻElua papa helu, ʻelua papa luna; hoʻololi ʻo TAKE ALL iā lāua pū. E ʻike ʻoe i kona waiwai i kēia pō.

column1: The chicken goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Aia ka moa ma kona papa iho. Kaomi + ma ka hopena o nā kapu papa helu.

column1: The lit tab is the playlist that gets the next cue. Its chip now says 'to Out 1': it is layered over playlist 1 on that output.
column2: Na ka papa helu o ke kapu ʻā e loaʻa ka cue aʻe. ʻŌlelo kona lepili 'i Puka 1': kau ʻo ia ma luna o ka papa helu 1 ma kēlā puka.

column1: Turnip Top has put the chicken in playlist 2. In playlist 1, TAKE 'The trunk (open)'. Then in playlist 2, TAKE the chicken.
column2: Ua waiho ʻo Turnip Top i ka moa ma ka papa helu 2. Ma ka papa helu 1, TAKE iā 'The trunk (open)'. A laila ma ka papa helu 2, TAKE i ka moa.

column1: The chicken is clear all round, so it covers only itself. Watch the monitor between the two TAKEs.
column2: Mōakāka nā wahi a puni ka moa; uhi wale i kona wahi iho. Nānā i ka pale ma waena o nā TAKE ʻelua.

column1: Did you see it? For a moment the trunk was open and empty: two TAKEs are two moments. The trick is reset. Now select the open trunk in playlist 1 and the chicken in playlist 2, then TAKE ALL.
column2: Ua ʻike? No hoʻokahi manawa ua wehe a hakahaka ka pahu: ʻelua TAKE, ʻelua manawa. Ua hoʻonohonoho hou ʻia ke kilokilo. Koho i ka pahu wehe ma ka papa helu 1 a me ka moa ma ka papa helu 2, a laila TAKE ALL.

column1: TAKE ALL takes every playlist's selected cue on one beat. No gap, no empty trunk.
column2: Lawe ʻo TAKE ALL i ka cue i koho ʻia ma kēlā papa helu i hoʻokahi paʻi. ʻAʻohe ā, ʻaʻohe pahu hakahaka.

column1: The chicken was late. They saw an empty trunk. In magic we call that a trunk.
column2: Ua lohi ka moa. Ua ʻike lākou i ka pahu hakahaka. Ma ke kilokilo, kapa mākou i kēlā he pahu.

column1: Trick two. Drag playlist 2's opacity fader down to nothing. The chicken fades away.
column2: Ke kilokilo lua. Huki iho i ka mea hoʻopaheʻe o ka māʻamaʻama o ka papa helu 2 i ka ʻole. Mae ka moa.

column1: Every playlist has its own opacity. Down is a fade out, with no cue at all.
column2: He māʻamaʻama ko kēlā papa helu iho. Ke iho, mae aku, me ka ʻole o ka cue.

column1: Ta-daaa! ...Hold for applause. Hold. Now watch it go.
column2: Ta-daaa! ...Kali i ka paʻipaʻi. Kali. Nānā i kona nalowale ʻana.

column1: Trick three. Bring it back: playlist 2's opacity all the way up.
column2: Ke kilokilo kolu. Hoʻihoʻi mai: hoʻokiʻekiʻe loa i ka māʻamaʻama o ka papa helu 2.

column1: Where did it go? Back in the trunk. Everything goes back in the trunk.
column2: Ua hele i hea? I ka pahu. Hoʻi nā mea a pau i ka pahu.

column1: An appearance done wrong, then right, a vanish and a return. Nazdrave.
column2: He puka hewa, a laila he pololei, he nalowale a he hoʻi. Nazdrave.

column1: A playlist can also sit on any output. Two layers, a great many tricks.
column2: Hiki ke waiho ka papa helu ma kekahi puka. ʻElua papa, nui nā kilokilo.

column1: It's back! Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Ua hoʻi mai! Mahalo! Aia au ma ʻaneʻi i ka pule a pau! Aia ka moa ma ʻaneʻi mau loa!

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. The kitchen is on fire. Press START.
column2: He hōʻike kuke, skapi. Ola. ʻĀ ke ahi i ka lumi kuke. Kaomi Hoʻomaka.
Ta-da! Ke kuke nei nō! ...Ke ʻā nei nō.

column1: Bork! De fire extinguisher is also on fire!
column2: Bork! Ke ʻā nei hoʻi ka mea kinai ahi-flurki!

column1: BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen.
column2: ʻELEʻELE e hūnā, PANIC e kū, TAKE e hoʻi. E ola ʻoe i kēlā lumi kuke kēia lumi kuke.

column1: A fashion show, skapi. One designer, one runway, and a look she will want back. Press START.
column2: He hōʻike lole, skapi. Hoʻokahi mea hoʻolālā, hoʻokahi ala hele, a he ʻano āna e makemake hou ai. Kaomi Hoʻomaka.

column1: A preset stores a whole look and brings it back with one button.
column2: Mālama ka hoʻonohonoho mua i ke ʻano holoʻokoʻa a hoʻihoʻi me hoʻokahi pihi.

column1: Darling. A look is not a look until you can get it back.
column2: E ke aloha. ʻAʻole he ʻano ka ʻano ke hiki ʻole ke hoʻihoʻi.

column1: Buttons. Good. I design with buttons.
column2: Nā pihi. Maikaʻi. Hoʻolālā au me nā pihi.

column1: Store it. Before somebody has ideas.
column2: Mālama. Ma mua o ka manaʻo hou o kekahi.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it.
column2: Pani i DASH (Esc), koho iā Look two a kaomi TAKE.

column1: A cape. On my runway. Someone will trip, darling. Someone always trips.
column2: He koloka. Ma koʻu ala hele. E hina kekahi, e ke aloha. Hina mau nō kekahi.

column1: Recall: the whole look comes back at once.
column2: Hoʻihoʻi: hoʻi pū ke ʻano holoʻokoʻa.

column1: Thank you. We will never speak of the cape again.
column2: Mahalo. ʻAʻole kākou e ʻōlelo hou no ke koloka.

column1: Simple. Timeless. Recallable. Now go, darling. I have a fitting.
column2: Maʻalahi. Mau loa. Hiki ke hoʻihoʻi. Hele, e ke aloha. He ana lole kaʻu.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white, and more. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Nā pahu, nā holoi, ka iris, ka mae i ke keʻokeʻo, a nui aʻe. Naʻu i kākau ka hapalua. I kekahi Pōʻalua.
E nā mea hoʻokele... hoʻolele i ka hoʻololi.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Roll credits.
column2: He ʻano, he manawa, a ʻelua komo nui. Hoʻolele i nā inoa hoʻopau.

column1: That is not an iris. ...It is better. I will allow it.
column2: ʻAʻole he iris kēlā. ...ʻOi aku ka maikaʻi. ʻAe au.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: He hopena, he pelu, he patch. ʻAe paha nā lopako. He mau pāpale kila ko lākou mau maka.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it. The agents did not.
column2: Waveform, vectorscope, waihoʻoluʻu hoʻopunipuni. Ua hoʻoholo nā ana. ʻAʻole nā ʻākena.
Ka nānā mai ke keʻena lele

column1: Major Tomasina is in orbit, skapi, and her picture has to reach the ground. Press START.
column2: Aia ʻo Major Tomasina i ka pōʻai honua, skapi, a pono e hiki kona kiʻi i ka honua. Kaomi Hoʻomaka.

column1: Pictures leave by cable or network: NDI, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: Hele nā kiʻi ma ke kaula a i ʻole ka pūnaewele: NDI, SDI mai ke kāleka DeckLink, ST 2110 no nā hale hoʻolele.

column1: Ground control, this is Major Tomasina. Can you see my picture?
column2: E ke kikowaena honua, ʻo Major Tomasina kēia. ʻIke ʻoukou i koʻu kiʻi?

column1: Every way down, on one page. Good. Space has very few cables.
column2: Nā ala iho a pau ma hoʻokahi ʻaoʻao. Maikaʻi. Kakaʻikahi ke kaula ma ka lewa.

column1: Sending now. If nobody answers, I'll just float here.
column2: Ke hoʻouna nei. Inā ʻaʻole pane kekahi, e lana wale au ma ʻaneʻi.

column1: Ground control, signing off. Tell my mother I waved.
column2: E ke kikowaena honua, aloha. Haʻi i koʻu makuahine ua peahi au.

column1: Ground control can see me! I can see my house from here.
column2: ʻIke ke kikowaena honua iaʻu! ʻIke au i koʻu hale mai ʻaneʻi.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late.
column2: A he puka aniani hou no ka uaki. ʻAʻole lohi nā mea hoʻokele e nānā i ka uaki.

column1: The big window is window one, which is usually the programme.
column2: ʻO ka puka aniani nui ka helu ʻekahi, ʻo ka papahana maʻamau.

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved.
column2: Nā puka aniani, ka papa kuhikuhi ..., NEXT, ka uaki, ka hoʻonohonoho, tally. Ua pau ka pohihihi.

column2: FX CHOICE: pono ke koho he A a i ʻole B

column2: FX CHOICE: ʻaʻohe hopena ma kēlā helu

column2: FX LFO: ʻo ka slot ʻo A-D no nā ʻāpana, ʻo E no ka nui, ʻo F a me G no ka ʻelima a me ke ono (a i ʻole 0-6)

column2: He helu, a hakahaka no ka nele

column1: Copies of copies: none at the left, four at the right. Each one loses more.
column2: N? kope o n? kope: ?a?ohe ma ka hema, ?eh? ma ka ??kau. Emi hou ka maika?i o k?l? me k?ia.

column1: How abruptly it arrives. Low is a soft cloud, high is a hard porthole.
column2: Ka hiki koke ?ana. He ao palupalu ka ha?aha?a, he puka poepoe ?oi ka ki?eki?e.

column1: How bright a pixel has to be before it lifts at all, so only the highlights spike.
column2: Ka m?lamalama e pono ai ke kiko ki?i e h?pai, i ku?i wale n? ??pana m?lamalama loa.

column1: How deep the picture is treated as being. The brightness becomes height and is lit from the side.
column2: Ka hohonu i mana?o ?ia no ke ki?i. Lilo ka m?lamalama i ki?eki?e a ho?om?lamalama ?ia mai ka ?ao?ao.

column1: How far away. Distance dulls the top and softens the difference between the ears.
column2: Ka mamao. Ho??mi ka mamao i n? leo ki?eki?e a me ka ?oko?a ma waena o n? pepeiao.

column1: How far back each skip jumps, from a stutter to half a second.
column2: Ka mamao ho?i o k?l? lele, mai ka ??kupe a i ka hapalua kekona.

column1: How gently the change fades out at the edges of the band.
column2: Ka m?lie o ka mae ?ana o ka loli ma n? lihi k??ei.

column1: How hard it holds once it is working. Gentle at the bottom, a limiter at the top.
column2: Ka ikaika o ka pa?a ke hana nei. M?lie ma lalo, he mea kaupalena ma luna.

column1: How irregular the growth is. Low gives an even honeycomb, high gives long shards.
column2: Ka like ?ole o ka ulu. He waihona meli kaulike ka ha?aha?a, he ??pana l??ihi ka ki?eki?e.

column1: How long it is allowed to run. More steps means the ripples have crossed and reflected more times.
column2: Ka l??ihi e ?ae ?ia e holo. ?Oi n? ka?ina, ?oi n? hala a me n? aniani ?ana o n? nalu.

column1: How long the reaction runs each frame. Short is a stain, long is an organism.
column2: Ka l??ihi o ka p?na?i i k?l? m?lina. He kiko ka p?kole, he mea ola ka l??ihi.

column1: How many places drip: a few big drips at the left, many thin ones at the right.
column2: Ka nui o n? wahi kulu: he mau kulu nui ma ka hema, he nui n? kulu lahilahi ma ka ??kau.

column1: How much of the picture glows: only the brightest at the left, nearly everything at the right.
column2: Ka m?hele o ke ki?i e ??lohilohi: n? mea ?oi loa ma ka hema, kokoke i n? mea a pau ma ka ??kau.

column1: How much of the picture shows behind the lines. None at the left: lines on black.
column2: Ka m?hele o ke ki?i ma hope o n? kaha. ?A?ohe ma ka hema: n? kaha ma ka ?ele?ele.

column1: How quickly the room eats the top end. More damping is a softer, more furnished space.
column2: Ka wikiwiki e moni ai ka lumi i n? leo ki?eki?e. He lumi palupalu me n? lako nui ka ho?om?lie nui.

column1: How readily an edge catches. Low sets the whole picture alight, high only the hardest lines.
column2: Ka ma?alahi e ?? ai ka lihi. Ho?? ka ha?aha?a i ke ki?i holo?oko?a, ke ki?eki?e i n? kaha ?oi loa wale n?.

column1: How wide a view is being compressed. Narrow is a punch down the middle, wide folds the whole frame into the centre.
column2: Ka laul? o ka ?ike e kaomi ?ia ana. He ho?oku?i kikowaena ka h?iki, pelu ka laul? i ka m?lina holo?oko?a i ke kikowaena.

column1: Line pitch in pixels, so this reads at 4K as well as at 720.
column2: Ka hakahaka o n? kaha ma n? kiko ki?i, i ?ike ?ia ma 4K a me 720.

column1: The head drifting off the track: a band of noise rolls through the picture.
column2: Ka he?e ?ana o ke po?o mai ke ala lipine: he k??ei wala?au e ?oloka?a ana ma ke ki?i.

column1: Two is a mirror, twelve is a snowflake, and they are completely different pictures.
column2: He aniani ka ?elua, he pua hau ka ?umikumam?lua, a ?oko?a loa n? ki?i.

column2: OUTPUT HDR WHITE: pono 80..500 nits (ʻo 203 ka BT.2408)

column2: BLEND PAIR: pono <helu hoʻopuka ʻē aʻe> <uhi like ma nā pika>

column1: Below the middle narrows toward mono -- which is what a single PA cluster is. Above it widens.
column2: Ma lalo o ka waena, emi i ke kani mono -- e like me ka pūʻulu leo PA hoʻokahi. Ma luna, ākea aʻe.

column1: Blueshift toward the direction of travel and redshift at the rim. Zero leaves the colour alone and it reads as a lens instead.
column2: Neʻe i ka polū ma ke ala o ka holo a i ka ʻulaʻula ma ke kihi. ʻAʻole hoʻololi ka ʻole i ke kala, a ʻano like ia me ke aniani nānā.

column1: Bright: bright things drip over the dark, as text and logos do. Whole picture: everything is wax, and the picture itself runs down in its own colours.
column2: Mālamalama: kulu nā mea mālamalama ma luna o ka pouli, e like me ke kikokikona a me nā hōʻailona. Kiʻi holoʻokoʻa: he piula nā mea a pau, a kahe ke kiʻi i lalo me kona mau kala.

column1: Centre is a straight line. Up bends it into an S -- darker shadows, brighter highlights, more contrast. Down flattens it.
column2: He kaha pololei ka waena. Hoʻopiʻo ka luna i ke ʻano S -- pouli aʻe nā aka, mālamalama aʻe nā mea ʻōlinolino, ʻokoʻa aʻe. Hoʻopālahalaha ka lalo.

column1: Characters across. Fewer means bigger cells and less of the picture surviving, which is usually the point.
column2: Nā huapalapala ma ka ʻākea. Ke emi, nui aʻe nā keʻena a emi ke kiʻi i koe, ʻo ia nō ke kumu maʻamau.

column1: Characters to build the picture from, darkest first. Empty uses the chosen glyph set.
column2: Nā huapalapala e kūkulu ai i ke kiʻi, ka pouli mua. Ke hakahaka, hoʻohana ʻia ka pūʻulu hōʻailona i koho ʻia.

column1: Colour is recorded at a fraction of the detail: it smears sideways, lands late and its hue wanders.
column2: Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ke kala me kekahi hapa o ke kikoʻī: pālahalaha i ka ʻaoʻao, hiki lohi mai, a auwana kona kala.

column1: DASH SET: needs a command -- DASH SET <n> <label> | <command> [| <glyph>]
column2: DASH SET: pono he kauoha -- DASH SET <n> <label> | <command> [| <glyph>]

column1: DMXCUE SET: expected channel=level pairs, e.g. 1=255,10-14=64
column2: DMXCUE SET: pono nā pālua channel=level, e laʻa 1=255,10-14=64

column1: DRAW COLOUR: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, a name, or 1-8 for the palette
column2: DRAW COLOUR: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, he inoa, a i ʻole 1-8 no ka papa kala

column1: DRAW TOOL: brush, erase, line, box, oval or fill
column2: DRAW TOOL: brush, erase, line, box, oval a i ʻole fill

column2: FADE TO: he māmā mai 0.25 a 4 (ʻo 0.5 ka hapalua māmā, hoʻokahi ʻoketa i lalo)

column1: FADE WHAT: expected opacity, volume, dimmer, brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, effect, audiofx or speed
column2: FADE WHAT: pono opacity, volume, dimmer, brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, effect, audiofx a i ʻole speed

column1: FX LFO: on, off, shape, rate, depth, zone, channel or cc
column2: FX LFO: on, off, shape, rate, depth, zone, channel a i ʻole cc

column1: FX: use LIST | ADD <effect> [amount] | AMOUNT <n> <v> | PARAM <n> <A-F> <0-1> | CHOICE <n> <A|B> <name> | LFO <n> <A-G> ... | COPY | PASTE | CLEAR
column2: FX: e hoʻohana iā LIST | ADD <effect> [amount] | AMOUNT <n> <v> | PARAM <n> <A-F> <0-1> | CHOICE <n> <A|B> <name> | LFO <n> <A-G> ... | COPY | PASTE | CLEAR

column1: Fields per frame, 0-4 (1 = one field per rendered frame) (supports + - * / and ())
column2: Nā kahua i kēlā pā kiʻi, 0-4 (1 = hoʻokahi kahua i kēlā pā kiʻi i hana ʻia) (kākoʻo iā + - * / a me ())

column1: Flip across, upside down or both, or fold one half onto the other: right onto left, left onto right, bottom onto top, top onto bottom, or one corner into all four.
column2: Huli ma ka ʻaoʻao, i lalo a i ʻole lāua ʻelua, a i ʻole pelu i kekahi hapalua ma luna o kekahi: ʻākau ma luna o hema, hema ma luna o ʻākau, lalo ma luna o luna, luna ma luna o lalo, a i ʻole hoʻokahi kihi i nā kihi ʻehā.

column1: GEOLFO: x, y, width, height, rotation, cropleft, cropright, croptop or cropbottom
column2: GEOLFO: x, y, width, height, rotation, cropleft, cropright, croptop a i ʻole cropbottom

column1: How bright a pixel has to be to join a run. Lower catches more of the picture and the runs grow longer.
column2: Ka mālamalama e pono ai ka pika e komo i ke kaha. Hoʻokomo ka haʻahaʻa i nā mea hou aʻe o ke kiʻi a lōʻihi aʻe nā kaha.

column1: How faint a gradient still registers. High turns the quietest shading into visible structure.
column2: Ka nāwaliwali o ka loli kala e ʻike ʻia ai. Hoʻolilo ka kiʻekiʻe i nā aka palupalu loa i ʻano i ʻike ʻia.

column1: How far back the chain listens. The picture is played through a delay, so this is the distance the damage is dragged across.
column2: Ka mamao i hope e hoʻolohe ai ke kaulahao. Hoʻokani ʻia ke kiʻi ma o ka hoʻopaneʻe, no laila ʻo kēia ka mamao e kauō ʻia ai ka pōʻino.

column1: How far the burn spreads off the edge, and how hot its colour runs.
column2: Ka mamao e laha ai ke ahi mai ke kihi, a me ka wela o kona kala.

column1: How far the colour turns on each trip round the loop. This is the oil-slick: the trail walks through the spectrum instead of fading.
column2: Ka nui o ke kaʻapuni kala i kēlā pōʻai kēia pōʻai. ʻO ia ka ʻaila lana: hele ka meheu ma ke ānuenue ma mua o ka nalo ʻana.

column1: How far the picture stands out. Bright parts come forward, dark parts stay back. At the left it is flat.
column2: Ka nui e puka ai ke kiʻi. Hele mai nā māhele mālamalama i mua, noho nā māhele pouli i hope. Ma ka hema he pālahalaha.

column1: How far the picture swings the filter. The cue's own brightness opens and closes it, so a cut to black takes the top off the sound.
column2: Ka nui e hoʻoneʻe ai ke kiʻi i ke kānana. Na ka mālamalama o ka māka e wehe a pani, no laila wehe ka ʻoki i ka pouli i nā alapine kiʻekiʻe o ke kani.

column1: How far the top comes down as the end approaches. This is not a fade: the level is left alone.
column2: Ka nui e emi ai nā alapine kiʻekiʻe i ka hoʻokokoke ʻana i ka hopena. ʻAʻole kēia he hoʻopio mālie: noho ka nui leo.

column1: How fast it settles away while held. At zero it holds indefinitely, which is what room tone under a held title wants.
column2: Ka māmā o ka nalo ʻana i ka paʻa ʻana. Ma ka ʻole, paʻa mau, e like me ke kani lumi ma lalo o ke poʻo inoa paʻa.

column1: How fast the open slit crosses the picture. Slow smears a long moment across the frame.
column2: Ka māmā e hele ai ka māwae hāmama ma ke kiʻi. Hoʻopālahalaha ka lohi i kekahi manawa lōʻihi ma ka pā kiʻi.

column1: How fast the wave travels. Faster spreads further in the same time and interferes more.
column2: Ka māmā e holo ai ka nalu. Laha ka māmā aʻe i kahi mamao aʻe i ka manawa like a hui hou aʻe nā nalu.

column1: How fast what has dripped hardens away. At the left the drips stay until the cue changes.
column2: Ka māmā e paʻa a nalo ai nā kulu. Ma ka hema, noho nā kulu a hoʻololi ka māka.

column1: How fine the water is. Long ocean swell at one end, rain on a puddle at the other.
column2: Ka liʻiliʻi o nā nalu wai. He ʻōhū kai lōʻihi ma kekahi ʻaoʻao, he ua ma kekahi pūnāwai liʻiliʻi ma kekahi.

column1: How hard the light gathers where the rays converge. This is the part that makes it read as water rather than as a wobble.
column2: Ka ikaika e ʻākoakoa ai ka mālamalama i ka hui ʻana o nā kukuna. Na kēia e like ai me ka wai ma mua o ka luliluli wale.

column1: How hard the moving parts throw sand. More shake clears the plate faster and makes the lines thinner.
column2: Ka ikaika e kiola ai nā māhele neʻe i ke one. Hoʻomaʻemaʻe ka haʻalulu nui i ka papa me ka māmā aʻe a lahilahi aʻe nā kaha.

column1: How long a grain is, in VIDEO FRAMES. On a 23.976 clip one frame is 41.7ms, which is not a musical value and is exactly the point.
column2: Ka lōʻihi o hoʻokahi huna ma nā PĀ KIʻI WIKIŌ. Ma kahi ʻāpana 23.976 he 41.7ms ka pā hoʻokahi, ʻaʻole he ana mele, ʻo ia nō ke kumu.

column1: How long before the end it starts. The cue has to have a known length -- an open-ended one has no end to resolve into.
column2: Ka manawa ma mua o ka hopena e hoʻomaka ai. Pono e ʻike ʻia ka lōʻihi o ka māka -- ʻaʻohe hopena o ka māka wehe e hoʻi ai.

column1: How long the old waves linger when the note changes. Left: they die at once. Right: they slosh for a while.
column2: Ka lōʻihi e noho ai nā nalu kahiko ke hoʻololi ka nota. Hema: make koke. ʻĀkau: holoholo iki.

column1: How much each facet catches the light, which is what makes them read as faceted rather than as flat blobs.
column2: Ka nui e hopu ai kēlā alo kēia alo i ka mālamalama, i ʻike ʻia nā alo ma mua o nā ʻāpana pālahalaha.

column1: How much its SIZE becomes distance. Shrink the picture and the sound goes away from you: the top comes off, the image narrows, the level drops.
column2: Ka nui e lilo ai kona NUI i mamao. Hoʻēmi i ke kiʻi a mamao ke kani: emi nā alapine kiʻekiʻe, haiki ke kiʻi kani, emi ka nui leo.

column1: How much of the bent picture goes round again. High is where it stops being an echo and starts eating itself.
column2: Ka nui o ke kiʻi piʻo e hele hou ai i ka pōʻai. Ma ke kiʻekiʻe, pau ka leo kuʻi a hoʻomaka e ʻai iā ia iho.

column1: How much of the driver's movement the picture KEEPS. At zero it follows the driver frame by frame, which is a twitch. Wind it up and the motion accumulates, so the driver sculpts the picture over time and it holds the pose -- which is what puppetry means.
column2: Ka nui o ka neʻe o ka mea alakaʻi a ke kiʻi e MĀLAMA ai. Ma ka ʻole hahai i kēlā pā kiʻi kēia pā, he ʻōniʻoniʻo. Hoʻonui a ʻākoakoa ka neʻe, e kālai ai ka mea alakaʻi i ke kiʻi i ka hala ʻana o ka manawa a paʻa kona kūlana -- e like me ka papeti.

column1: How much of the picture's position on the output is used. A PIP on the left sounds on the left -- and it is a placement, not a pan: the far ear gets the delay and the head shadow too.
column2: Ka nui e hoʻohana ʻia ai ke kūlana o ke kiʻi ma ka hoʻopuka. Kani he PIP ma ka hema ma ka hema -- he hoʻonoho ia, ʻaʻole he pan: loaʻa i ka pepeiao mamao ka lohi a me ke aka o ke poʻo.

column1: How much of the tail is kept going while the cue is held. Long enough to hide the splice in room tone, short enough not to smear a rhythm in it.
column2: Ka nui o ka huelo kani e hoʻomau ai i ka paʻa ʻana o ka māka. Lōʻihi e hūnā i ka humuhumu kani lumi, pōkole e hoʻopālahalaha ʻole i ke kuʻi.

column1: How much room comes up under it, so the sound settles into the cut instead of being severed.
column2: Ka nui o ke kani lumi e ala mai ma lalo, i noho ke kani i loko o ka ʻoki ma mua o ke ʻoki koke ʻia.

column1: How much the echo is distorted each pass. It compounds, so a little ripples and a lot melts the picture into itself.
column2: Ka nui e hoʻopio ʻia ai ka leo kuʻi i kēlā hala kēia hala. Hoʻonuihui ia, no laila nalu ka liʻiliʻi a hoʻoheheʻe ka nui i ke kiʻi i loko ona iho.

column1: How much the material draws in towards each drip, so it runs as a thin neck with a heavier head.
column2: Ka nui e huki ʻia ai ka mea i kēlā kulu, i kahe me ka ʻāʻī lahilahi a me ke poʻo kaumaha.

column1: How often its settings are corrupted. Corrupted far enough it oscillates on its own -- loud, but it cannot run away.
column2: Ka pinepine e hōʻino ʻia ai kona hoʻonohonoho. Ke nui ka hōʻino, haʻalulu nona iho -- nui ke kani akā ʻaʻole hiki ke holo wale aku.

column1: How quickly the picture springs back to rest once the driver stops pushing it. Only does anything when memory is up.
column2: Ka māmā e hoʻi ai ke kiʻi i ka hoʻomaha ke pau ka pahu ʻana a ka mea alakaʻi. Hana wale inā hoʻonui ʻia ka hoʻomanaʻo.

column1: How small a cut sets it off. With no picture it runs on a timer instead, and this is how often.
column2: Ka liʻiliʻi o ka ʻoki e hoʻā ai. Me ka ʻole o ke kiʻi, holo ma ka uaki, ʻo kēia kona pinepine.

column1: How strongly the finished picture pushes the bend. Pair it with a picture effect whose LFO is set to Audio and the two drive each other.
column2: Ka ikaika e pahu ai ke kiʻi hope i ka piʻo. Hoʻohui me ka hopena kiʻi nona ka LFO i koho ʻia iā Audio a hoʻokele lāua kekahi i kekahi.

column1: LFO: density, speed, warp, turn, centrex, centrey, grey or hue
column2: LFO: density, speed, warp, turn, centrex, centrey, grey a i ʻole hue

column1: Lift or cut, 12dB either way. The centre is flat, so a band that has just been added does nothing until this is moved.
column2: Hoʻonui a ʻoki, 12dB ma nā ʻaoʻao ʻelua. Pālahalaha ka waena, no laila ʻaʻole hana ke kaha hou a hoʻoneʻe ʻia kēia.

column1: Light on the drips, as on something wet: a gloss where it faces the light, darker where it curls away.
column2: Ka mālamalama ma nā kulu, e like me ka mea pulu: ʻōlinolino ma ke alo i ka mālamalama, pouli ma ke piʻo ʻana aku.

column1: MASK SET: expected INVERT, X, Y, SCALE, ROTATION, FEATHER, GROW or OPACITY and a number
column2: MASK SET: pono INVERT, X, Y, SCALE, ROTATION, FEATHER, GROW a i ʻole OPACITY a me ka helu

column1: MIDIIN: NOTE <n> <vel>, NOTEOFF <n>, CC <c> <v>, PITCH <0-16383>, PRESSURE <v>, KEYPRESSURE <n> <v>, PROGRAM <n> or OSC <address> [<n>], then CH <1-16> if not channel 1
column2: MIDIIN: NOTE <n> <vel>, NOTEOFF <n>, CC <c> <v>, PITCH <0-16383>, PRESSURE <v>, KEYPRESSURE <n> <v>, PROGRAM <n> a i ʻole OSC <address> [<n>], a laila CH <1-16> inā ʻaʻole ke ala 1

column1: MIDIMAP: LIST, ADD, SET, REMOVE, CLEAR, RESET, LEARN, LEARNED, PRESET or FEEDBACK
column2: MIDIMAP: LIST, ADD, SET, REMOVE, CLEAR, RESET, LEARN, LEARNED, PRESET a i ʻole FEEDBACK

column1: MULTIVIEW WINDOW <n>: expected a source, or SAFE/METER/LABEL ON|OFF
column2: MULTIVIEW WINDOW <n>: pono he kumu, a i ʻole SAFE/METER/LABEL ON|OFF

column1: Moves the direction of travel off the centre of frame, so the picture rushes past rather than straight at you.
column2: Hoʻoneʻe i ke ala holo mai ka waena o ka pā kiʻi, i holo ke kiʻi ma kou ʻaoʻao ma mua o ke alo pololei iā ʻoe.

column1: N=new  Enter/P=previous  O=open saved  E=examples  L=learn  1-
column2: N=hou  Enter/P=mua  O=wehe i mālama ʻia  E=laʻana  L=aʻo  1-

column1: NMOS: NOT registering - network is LOCAL ONLY (turn REMOTE ON to publish)
column2: NMOS: ʻAʻOLE e kākau inoa - he KŪLOKO WALE ka pūnaewele (hoʻā iā REMOTE ON e hoʻolaha)

column1: OUTPUT SPOUT: ON | OFF | TOGGLE | NAME <sender name>
column2: OUTPUT SPOUT: ON | OFF | TOGGLE | NAME <inoa mea hoʻouna>

column1: One knob for the whole balance: below the middle is darker, above it is brighter.
column2: Hoʻokahi pihi wili no ke kaulike holoʻokoʻa: pouli aʻe ma lalo o ka waena, mālamalama aʻe ma luna.

column1: Original: the picture pulled onto the figure. Sand: the picture as grains that are thrown off the moving parts and pour into each new figure. Fluid: the picture under water on the plate, bent and lit by its standing waves.
column2: Kumu: ke kiʻi i huki ʻia ma luna o ke kinona. One: ke kiʻi he mau huna e kiola ʻia mai nā māhele neʻe a kahe i kēlā kinona hou kēia kinona. Wai: ke kiʻi ma lalo o ka wai ma ka papa, i hoʻopiʻo a hoʻomālamalama ʻia e kona mau nalu kū.

column1: PHONE LEVEL: removed -- a paired phone or the passphrase can do everything; BLACKOUT and RECORD are hold-to-fire on the phone
column2: PHONE LEVEL: ua wehe ʻia -- hiki i ke kelepona i hoʻopili ʻia a i ʻole ka ʻōlelo huna ke hana i nā mea a pau; paʻa kaomi iā BLACKOUT a me RECORD ma ke kelepona e hoʻā

column1: PowerPoint could not export this file (it may need permission to be automated: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation)
column2: ʻAʻole hiki iā PowerPoint ke hoʻokuʻu i kēia waihona (pono paha ka ʻae no ka hana ʻakomi: Nā Koho ʻŌnaehana > Pilikino a me Palekana > Hana ʻakomi)

column1: PowerPoint could not open the file (it gave up waiting for it). If it is in OneDrive, right-click it and choose Always keep on this device, then import it again
column2: ʻAʻole hiki iā PowerPoint ke wehe i ka waihona (ua pau ke kali ʻana). Inā ma OneDrive, kaomi ʻākau a koho iā Mālama mau ma kēia hāmeʻa, a hoʻokomo hou

column1: Pulls the bright tones down without moving pure white, so a hot highlight rolls off instead of clipping.
column2: Hoʻohaʻahaʻa i nā leo kala mālamalama me ka hoʻoneʻe ʻole i ke keʻokeʻo maʻemaʻe, i emi mālie ai ka mālamalama nui ma mua o ke ʻoki ʻia.

column1: Rotates the reading, so straight lines wind into spirals rather than rings.
column2: Kaʻapuni i ka heluhelu ʻana, i lilo nā kaha pololei i wili ma mua o nā apo.

column1: Rows lose sync and repeat one character, the way a real text screen breaks up. At 0 the grid is clean.
column2: Nalo ka lōkahi o nā lālani a hana hou i hoʻokahi huapalapala, e like me ka haki ʻana o ka pale kikokikona maoli. Ma 0 maʻemaʻe ka māhele kaha.

column1: SLICE <n>: CROP, PLACE, CORNER, EDGE, MASK, SOURCE, ROTATE, FLIP, OPACITY, LFO, ON, OFF, LINEAR, PERSPECTIVE or NAME
column2: SLICE <n>: CROP, PLACE, CORNER, EDGE, MASK, SOURCE, ROTATE, FLIP, OPACITY, LFO, ON, OFF, LINEAR, PERSPECTIVE a i ʻole NAME

column1: SLICE CORNER: TL, TR, BR or BL, then dx dy in percent of the output
column2: SLICE CORNER: TL, TR, BR a i ʻole BL, a laila dx dy ma ka pākēneka o ka hoʻopuka

column1: SLICE EDGE: L, R, T or B, then 0-50 (% of the slice)
column2: SLICE EDGE: L, R, T a i ʻole B, a laila 0-50 (% o ka ʻāpana)

column1: SLICE GRID POINT: col row (from 1, on a grid that is on) then dx dy in percent
column2: SLICE GRID POINT: col row (mai 1, ma ka māhele kaha i hoʻā ʻia) a laila dx dy ma ka pākēneka

column1: SLICE GRID: <cols> <rows> (2-9), OFF, SMOOTH ON|OFF, or POINT col row dx dy
column2: SLICE GRID: <cols> <rows> (2-9), OFF, SMOOTH ON|OFF, a i ʻole POINT col row dx dy

column1: SLICE LFO: X, Y, ROTATION or OPACITY, then ON, OFF, SHAPE, RATE, DEPTH...
column2: SLICE LFO: X, Y, ROTATION a i ʻole OPACITY, a laila ON, OFF, SHAPE, RATE, DEPTH...

column1: SLICE ROTATE: IN (the crop) or OUT (the placed picture), then degrees
column2: SLICE ROTATE: IN (ka ʻoki) a i ʻole OUT (ke kiʻi i hoʻonoho ʻia), a laila degere

column1: Scanlines, bloom and gun misalignment, 0-1 (supports + - * / and ())
column2: Nā kaha kilohi, ʻōlinolino a me ka pololei ʻole o nā pū kukuna, 0-1 (kākoʻo iā + - * / a me ())

column1: Something near the deck: a phone's buzz, a light dimmer's herringbone, a radio's slow bars.
column2: Kekahi mea kokoke i ka pā: ka haʻalulu kelepona, ke kaha o ka mea hoʻomalu kukui, nā kaha lohi o ka lēkiō.

column1: Takes out everything brighter than this as well. Left takes out nothing.
column2: Wehe pū i nā mea a pau i mālamalama aʻe. Ma ka hema, ʻaʻohe mea i wehe ʻia.

column1: Takes out everything darker than this, so what lies beneath shows through. Left takes out nothing.
column2: Wehe i nā mea a pau i pouli aʻe, i ʻike ʻia ka mea ma lalo. Ma ka hema, ʻaʻohe mea i wehe ʻia.

column1: Tape speed: SP is the best picture, LP and EP fit more on a tape and lose detail and colour.
column2: Māmā lipine: ʻo SP ke kiʻi maikaʻi loa, hoʻokomo ʻo LP a me EP i nā mea hou aʻe ma ka lipine akā emi ke kikoʻī a me ke kala.

column1: The brightness that stays put. Everything above it reaches one way and everything below it the other.
column2: Ka mālamalama e kū mau ai. Kikoʻo nā mea ma luna i kekahi ala a nā mea ma lalo i kekahi.

column1: The character of the growth: low is waves, then labyrinth, coral, worms, and holes at the top.
column2: Ke ʻano o ka ulu: he nalu ma lalo, a laila he ala huikau, he ʻākoʻakoʻa, he ilo a he lua ma luna loa.

column1: The colour it becomes. Shading and brightness stay as they were, so a red shirt turns blue and keeps its folds.
column2: Ke kala e lilo ai. Noho ka malu a me ka mālamalama, no laila lilo ka pālule ʻulaʻula i polū a mālama i kona mau pelu.

column1: The distance that sits ON the screen. Either side of it comes forward or falls behind.
column2: Ka mamao e kū ana MA ka pale. Ma nā ʻaoʻao ʻelua, hele mai i mua a hoʻi i hope.

column1: The frequency it pivots around -- what counts as 'low' and 'high' for the tilt.
column2: Ke alapine e kaʻa ai a puni -- ka mea i kapa ʻia he 'haʻahaʻa' a he 'kiʻekiʻe' no ka hoʻoluli.

column1: The level below which the source is closed. Set it under the quietest thing you want to hear.
column2: Ka pae ma lalo ona e pani ʻia ai ke kumu. E hoʻonoho ma lalo o ka mea mālie loa āu e makemake ai e lohe.

column1: The level it starts working at. Lower catches more of the performance.
column2: Ka pae e hoʻomaka ai ka hana. Hopu ka haʻahaʻa i nā mea hou aʻe o ka hoʻokani.

column1: The plugin's first four automatable controls, in its own order. Everything else it has keeps whatever the plugin was left set to.
column2: Nā hoʻomalu ʻakomi mua ʻehā o ka mea hoʻohui, ma kona kaʻina ponoʻī. Mālama nā mea ʻē aʻe i ka hoʻonohonoho hope o ia mea.

column1: Tints the two directions apart, so light bending one way and the other are different colours instead of both being grey.
column2: Hoʻokaʻawale i nā ala ʻelua me ke kala, i ʻokoʻa ai nā kala o ka mālamalama e piʻo ana i kēlā ʻaoʻao kēia ʻaoʻao ma mua o ka hinahina ʻelua.

column1: Turns the strokes across the grain instead of along it, which combs the picture apart rather than smoothing it.
column2: Kaʻapuni i nā kaha ma ʻō aku o nā huna ma mua o ka hahai ʻana, e kahi kaʻawale ai ke kiʻi ma mua o ka hoʻopalupalu.

column1: Turns the whole arrangement, so the fold lines do not sit on the same part of the picture all night.
column2: Kaʻapuni i ka hoʻonohonoho holoʻokoʻa, i noho ʻole nā pelu ma ka ʻāpana like o ke kiʻi i ka pō holoʻokoʻa.

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT ASSIGN: already on this output, or no such deck or output
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT ASSIGN: ma kēia hoʻopuka nō, a i ʻole ʻaʻohe pā a hoʻopuka paha pēlā

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYER: this deck is not on this output, or it is already at that layer
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYER: ʻaʻole kēia pā ma kēia hoʻopuka, a i ʻole aia nō ma kēlā papa

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP MODE: linear or perspective
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP MODE: linear a i ʻole perspective

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP: expected OFF, MODE, or eight numbers clockwise from the top left
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP: pono OFF, MODE, a i ʻole ʻewalu helu ma ke ala uaki mai ka luna hema

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT UNASSIGN: this deck is not on this output, or it is the only thing on it
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT UNASSIGN: ʻaʻole kēia pā ma kēia hoʻopuka, a i ʻole ʻo ia wale nō ka mea ma laila

column1: WARP SELECT: expected TL, TR, BR, BL or a grid <col> <row>
column2: WARP SELECT: pono TL, TR, BR, BL a i ʻole he māhele kaha <col> <row>

column1: WEBMONITOR PIN: network sharing and phone control require 8 or more characters
column2: WEBMONITOR PIN: pono he 8 huapalapala a ʻoi no ke kaʻana pūnaewele a me ke kaohi kelepona

column1: WEBMONITOR: STATUS | ON | OFF | CONTROL ON|OFF | SHARE ON|OFF | SOURCE PROGRAMME|<output> | QR [ON|OFF] | PORT <n> | PIN <pin>|OFF (sound is included)
column2: WEBMONITOR: STATUS | ON | OFF | CONTROL ON|OFF | SHARE ON|OFF | SOURCE PROGRAMME|<output> | QR [ON|OFF] | PORT <n> | PIN <pin>|OFF (ua hui ke kani)

column1: Where highlights fold back through black. Low folds most of the picture, high folds only the brightest.
column2: Kahi e pelu hou ai nā mea mālamalama ma ka pouli. Pelu ka haʻahaʻa i ka hapa nui o ke kiʻi, ka kiʻekiʻe i nā mea mālamalama loa wale nō.

column1: Where the band sits, 30Hz to 16kHz across the travel.
column2: Kahi e noho ai ke kaha, 30Hz a 16kHz ma ke ala holo.

column1: Where the fold sits: the middle at the left, toward the far edge to the right. Flips have no fold.
column2: Kahi e noho ai ka pelu: ka waena ma ka hema, a kokoke i ke kihi mamao ma ka ʻākau. ʻAʻohe pelu o ka huli ʻana.

column1: Where the light stands, in degrees around the frame.
column2: Kahi e kū ai ka mālamalama, ma nā degere a puni ka pā kiʻi.

column1: Where the source sits around the listener, all the way round. For headphones -- it is a timing and shading trick, not a pan.
column2: Kahi e noho ai ke kumu a puni ka mea hoʻolohe, a puni loa. No nā pepeiao lohe -- he hana manawa a me ke aka kani, ʻaʻole he pan.

column1: Where the top ends, 200Hz to 20kHz. Pull it down to take the harshness off a bright source.
column2: Kahi e pau ai nā alapine kiʻekiʻe, 200Hz a 20kHz. Hoʻoiho e wehe i ke kani ʻoʻoleʻa o ke kumu mālamalama.

column1: Which channel the curve acts on: all three, then red, green or blue on its own -- the way a colourist warms or cools one end of the picture.
column2: Ke ala e hana ai ke kaha piʻo: nā ala ʻekolu, a laila ka ʻulaʻula, ʻōmaʻomaʻo a polū hoʻokahi -- e like me ka mea hoʻoponopono kala e hoʻomehana a hoʻomaʻalili i kekahi ʻaoʻao o ke kiʻi.

column1: Which way the knife edge lies. Only gradients ACROSS the edge show, so turning it swaps which features appear and which vanish.
column2: Ke ala e kū ai ke kihi pahi. ʻIke ʻia nā loli kala MA ʻŌ AKU o ke kihi wale nō, no laila hoʻololi ka hoʻohuli i nā hiʻona e ʻike a nalo ai.

column1: Which way the streak runs: across at the left, upright in the middle, across again at the right.
column2: Ke ala e holo ai ke kaha: moe ma ka hema, kū ma ka waena, moe hou ma ka ʻākau.

column1: Widens the decision into a ramp, so edges keep their shape instead of jagging.
column2: Hoʻonui i ka palena i loli mālie ai, i mālama nā kihi i ko lākou ʻano ma mua o ka niho ʻana.

column1: Words to surface in the field, separated by | . One shows at a time, moving on the hold clock.
column2: Nā huaʻōlelo e puka ai ma ke kahua, hoʻokaʻawale ʻia me | . Hōʻike hoʻokahi i kēlā manawa, hoʻololi ma ka uaki paʻa.
